race.comment: SIMPLY FUN (6) comes out of metro CL1 company at Eagle Farm, where he was fourth on soft ground, and first-time blinkers give him a genuine point of difference despite his modest record around 1400m. XTRA LA VITA (12) was good first-up when third at this track after covering ground throughout and looks capable of improving second-up. Thompson taking over is a big push. RUSSIAN ESCAPE (5) brings the narrowest recent miss, beaten a nose in a BM66 at Port Macquarie after racing wide, and his 1400m record keeps him right in the winning mix. MEASURE UP (1) was a sharp improver second-up and is open to further but will need some luck from the car park draw.
